Historical 20-year CAGR ~20%, last 3 years 23%; industry double-digit growth expected; optimistic on sustaining momentum
EBITDA margin expected in 2.5%-3% range for the business

Reasonably confident of double-digit growth in coming months and year excluding project orders

PAT margin improvement driven by gross profit in normal range, interest benefit from IPO proceeds, deferred tax component, and volume efficiencies
All 67 warehouses are leased/rented, connected via SAP ERP; mother warehouse ~1.5 lakh sq ft, small town ~1,500 sq ft

Long-term EBITDA margin target maintained at ~2.5%
Business not capex-heavy; expansion via offices and reach, not capital-intensive; working capital is primary requirement
Aspire to maintain double-digit growth in number of cities and customers
Maintain double-digit CAGR growth pace; Q3 seasonally weak but confident on YoY growth trajectory
CRISIL upgraded long-term rating to AA-/Stable and short-term to A1+
ROE target of 15% in 1-2 years, long-term 17-20%
Q4 EBITDA margin 3.23% driven by sales mix; annual margin 2.62% more representative
Embedded business margins higher than regular ICT distribution margins
Data center pipeline shifting from single large Rs 1,500 crore order to multiple smaller deals across locations
Embedded business revenue Rs 100+ crore in FY25, profitable at current scale
Advanced embedded lab established in Bangalore for design sampling and testing
Opened 52nd branch in Srinagar, expanding geographical presence
Long-term EBITDA margin guidance of 2.7%-2.8% annually
Aspiration to grow at 2x market growth rate for full year

No large deals executed in Q1; multiple large and mid-sized deals in pipeline for Q2-Q4 being evaluated for ROI
Government GPU order for 10,000 units likely to finalize in Q2; will evaluate margins and ROE before participating
Leveraging expansions done 2 years ago for economies of scale; no new capex mentioned
Aspiration to maintain 20% CAGR as achieved over last 20 years
1.5% PAT margin considered safe for long run
Focus on ROCE for large project deals with middle path approach
Strong funnel for large projects in Q3 and Q4
Dell Commercial business started with token revenue in Q2, substantial revenue expected in Q3
Two new branches opened in Nanded and Baramati, Maharashtra
Leases for warehouses and branches are long-term, typically 3-5 years
Management expects unit volumes to be flattish in FY27 with revenue growth driven by higher ASPs
Management expects continued positive revenue trend in coming quarters due to further price hikes and preponed demand
Q3 consolidated PAT margin was 1.85% with PAT of INR75 crores, up 132% YoY
Management expects margin trend to continue similar to Q3 with business market size, ASP and product mix all in similar mode
Opened new branch in Solapur, now 55 branches across 55 towns in India
Pan-India network serves 10,000+ distribution partners across 700+ locations nationwide
Large deal pipeline decent but execution slower due to supply extensions and price volatility; conversions expected in FY27
PC penetration growth expected at 12-15% in FY24-27E
Expanded distribution footprint with new branches in Nanded, Baramati, and Solapur
Management expects to maintain 20% CAGR trajectory in FY27
PAT margin range guided at 1.5-1.75% for distribution industry
Operating leverage benefits from price hikes as fixed costs remain same
AI data center project funnel at INR 20,000-25,000 crores under consideration
Added 3 new branches in Maharashtra taking total to 55 branch offices
Distribution network covers 55 city branches, 10,000+ customers across 700+ towns
Expect similar LIT 24% and PES 37% growth ratio to continue in FY27
Working capital expected to remain around same range of 58 days in FY27
Added two new branches in Udaipur (Rajasthan) and Dhule (Maharashtra) in Q1-FY27
Expects similar demand trend to continue in Q2 FY27 and entire FY27, though price increase trajectory may slow down
Q2 FY27 expected to have similar growth trend as Q1, but price increase speed should be half
Consolidated EBITDA margin 3.38%, PAT margin 2.05%; standalone EBITDA margin 3.38%, PAT margin 2.01%; gross margin impacted by product mix shift to lower-margin PES segment
Opening two new branches in Udaipur and Dhule to extend reach into C and D class cities
AI data center pipeline strong for next 3 quarters; participating in neo-clouds and niche operators; VDA integration for joint bidding few quarters away
Long-term 20% CAGR target maintained for next few years; VDA and Restar JV are strategies for sustained growth beyond current cycle
Management expects H2 FY27 price increases of 10-15% and flattish unit volumes, with commercial positive and consumer negative.
Sustainable EBITDA margin for long-term horizons (FY29-30) guided at around 2.75%.
Interest cost expected to remain in the same range as H1 FY27, including acquisition debt.
Debt-to-equity target maintained at 1:1, barring temporary opportunities where ROCE makes sense.
Consolidated Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 106 bps to 3.56%; PAT margin improved 69 bps to 2.1%.
Gross margins improved ~100 bps in Q2; expansion driven by mix and pricing discipline, not just operating leverage.
Semiconductor business margins broadly 2x company-level margins; H1 FY27 semiconductor revenue 2x full FY26, targeting 3-4x for full FY27.
Enterprise/data center opportunity >INR20,000 crores of orders placed in last quarter; company chose not to play active role due to 50% growth and lower ROIs.
Targeting enterprise business to contribute ~20% of revenue next year; semiconductor and VDA to contribute >10% of top line.
QIP of INR900 crores prepared as growth capital for capacity building at 40-60% YoY growth; may not execute if not needed.
INR900 crores QIP with 1:1 debt-equity gives INR1,800-2,000 crores deployable capital, supporting INR12,000-15,000 crores additional revenue at 6-7x working capital cycles.
Acquired 67% stake in VDA Infosolutions for enterprise IT, cloud, cybersecurity, system integration and managed services.
Formed JV with Restar Corporation (Japan) for semiconductor and embedded solutions; 2 Japanese brands added, design center in Bangalore with Restar engineer deputed.
